channel.title: fresh grooves friday · groovesMAXXING
channel.description: the releases that survived the week, an artist worth knowing, where they are playing next. every friday.

item.title: issue 011 · 9 october 2026 · someone tell the guy next to you to stop talking
item.description: the dance floor has a talking problem and two of our guys finally said it. 15+ records survived the cut and four of them became our first top picks. iii points set times are out, both nights end in a three-way clash, and five tagged sets sit down the page.

item.title: issue 010 · 2 october 2026 · arya stone, kamjam and papillon split the week three ways, and 20+ survived
item.description: 100+ records dropped and 20+ made it through the cut. one track of the week was not going to cut it, so three share it. the contraband pick is a free download, and the sets card is back with five from the last seven days.

item.title: issue 009 · 25 september 2026 · polovich and bipolar sunshine split the week, and we tagged six sets
item.description: 30+ records made it through and one track of the week was not enough, so dirty dancing and stay share it. six tracklists went up, the site grew 60+ label pages, and the contraband will never see a store.

item.title: issue 008 · 18 september 2026 · peace control took the week, and we tagged five sets
item.description: nineteen records made it through. peace control and luca saporito take track of the week, and peace control happens to be playing denver in three weeks. five tracklists went up, six IDs came straight from the artists who made them, and iii points finally showed its hand. no set times yet, we checked.

item.title: issue 007 · 11 september 2026 · girlfriend, the final boss, and 20+ that survived
item.description: broken hill took the week with girlfriend, adam ten took the tracklists with a 34-track sunset in barcelona. 20+ survived the cut, contraband sat this one out, and there were almost twelve hours of soundcloud-only sets down the page.

item.title: issue 006 · 4 september 2026 · mau p took the week, cloonee took red rocks
item.description: on time this week. barely. mau p wins the week with just a little bit more, fifteen survive the cut, two edits land in contraband, and cloonee's red rocks set gets the full timestamp treatment on our youtube. plus five sets of the week and a taste of the 100+ drop.

item.title: issue 005 · 28 august 2026 · gkat takes the week, the sets get timestamps
item.description: seventeen for the club, four for daylight, gkat's disco powder on top. two edits into contraband, five full sets from the week, and the dj sets on our youtube start getting timestamped, unreleased ids included.

item.title: issue 004 · 21 august 2026 · seventeen survive the cut, miami turns october into a week
item.description: on time this week. barely. seventeen records survived the cut, a track of the week off a mexican label, and III points quietly turned october 16-17 into october 13-20. plus what we've been building on the site while you weren't looking.

item.title: issue 003 · 14 august 2026 · bibi and kettama on circoloco, AYYBO flips chris lake
item.description: a late one, and a heavy one. michael bibi and KETTAMA land on circoloco, AYYBO takes apart a tiga and chris lake record, and the track of the week isn't even from this week, which is the whole point of the section.

item.title: issue 002 · 7 august 2026 · official kickoff 👑 huge weekend for max styler and nu moda
item.description: solomun and max styler put records out on the same friday. eight picks, the first contraband of the week, and the story of how max styler nearly quit in 2020 and who talked him out of it. plus the label nobody's talking about yet.

item.title: issue 001 · 31 july 2026 · the first one, and the receipts
item.description: the first one. eight picks, a track of the week that had been sitting in a soundcloud upload since the 15th, and the receipts on what it took to find them.
